inviteSheet.name: Name
inviteSheet.body:
We'd like you to join us as a sales agent for our four canned cocktails: Aloha, Gaia, Santorini and Kyoto.

Your commission is {perUnit} per unit sold, plus VAT. It becomes ready to pay once your customer has paid in full.

Set your password with the link below. It works for {days} days.
